description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Trigger A creature attacks you, or a spell effect enters your space.

You sever it. The attack or effect has no effect.

Automation note: Foundry has no hook that lets a third party void an attack or a spell already in motion — the same limit that keeps Taurus' Titan's Stance from retargeting an incoming attack. This action exists so the frequency is real and a click records that it happened; what "no effect" undoes is the table's call. The guide's "once per turn per creature" is a per-creature limit pf2e's own frequency tracking cannot express, so this enforces once per turn, flat.

Granted by the Capricorn Zenith Boon.
